resources.name: Cu-Ti EAM interatomic potential (Sabochick and Lam, Phys. Rev. B 43, 1991)

access.notes: Potential parameters and functional form are given in the published paper; can be extracted and implemented for EAM-style simulations.

The structures (D1a for Cu4Ti, Frank-Kasper for Cu4Ti3, B11 for CuTi, C15b for CuTi2) are known crystal structures. Atomic positions and lattice constants can be obtained from crystallographic databases or the paper itself.
